create_vibevoice_asr_config: create a VibeVoiceAsrConfig with acoustic, semantic, and text sub-configs for ASR model initialization
initialize_vibevoice_acoustic_tokenizer: initialize a VibeVoiceAsrConfig with default acoustic tokenizer encoder config for audio feature extraction
configure_semantic_tokenizer: configure a VibeVoiceAsrConfig with custom semantic tokenizer encoder config specifying hidden_size
